primitive_rules.circle: One canonical arc(x,y,r,0,2*pi): five numeric geometry operands.
primitive_rules.ellipse: One canonical ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,rotate,0,2*pi): seven numeric geometry operands.
primitive_rules.round_rect: Four x/y/w/h operands plus four normalised circular corner radii. A scalar radius expands to four, without approximating native rounded geometry.
primitive_rules.arc: Five x/y/r/start/end operands; close adds no number.
primitive_rules.polygon: A sharp n-sided polygon has n coordinate pairs. A rounded polygon uses one M or L pair and one Q quadruple per vertex: 6*n operands, matching the existing rounded hexagon algorithm.
primitive_rules.path: Count numeric M/L/Q/C operands, including implicit repeats and scientific notation; Z has zero. Transform/style/colour/easing operands are not path numbers.
primitive_rules.ref: Expand one non-ref definition then apply permitted overrides. Count each use, never only the shared definition.

expansion.ordinary_item: One painted item for each shape with any reachable normal paint or emission. Emission-only geometry contributes one item and its geometry operands even with no normal fill/stroke/outline.
expansion.paint: One normal pass per enabled fill, detail stroke, primary outline and secondary outline. A named emitter/glyph group adds one blurred pass per distinct compatible paint operation: merge same-operation subpaths only with equal alpha and, for strokes, equal width/cap/join. Fill and stroke never merge. Emission-only geometry uses a fill mask. No occlusion culling.
expansion.ellipse_clip: One shared inset ellipse clip per eye using iris/pupil/glints/lid/edge. Add seven path numbers for that clip. Sclera/lashes are outside it.
expansion.lid_edge: Separate geometry and painted item from the lid rectangle; its line has four numeric operands. A stroke on the sclera instead reuses the sclera geometry.
expansion.face_outer_clip: One application and one target-geometry expansion per face invocation, not per glyph or item.
expansion.item_clip: One application and one target-geometry expansion per item invocation. Hidden targets contribute geometry and transform work, without an extra painted item/pass.
expansion.eye_dots: One circle item per dot. All dots of one eye are one glyph group for its single emission pass.
expansion.eye_arc_or_path: One item plus independent enabled lashes. eye_path defaults fill to feature; an explicit stroke adds a pass even on degenerate filled line geometry.
expansion.brow: One item per visible eye when width>0 and not hidden by the eye style or detail band.
expansion.mouth: Each mouth item counts separately, but all items belong to one mouth emission group.
expansion.blush_shadow: Two blush ellipses when a placement and positive control are active; one ground-shadow ellipse when configured.
expansion.effects: Kit effect items and reduced_items cannot carry clip: kit definitions have no character-specific part/item binding. Count ordinary mapped effect instances plus all possibly overlapping trigger instances in the selected gesture. Never deduplicate by effect name or anchor; retriggering creates a separate instance, clipped to the action deadline. Maximum is over one playable gesture/change, not a sum of mutually exclusive gestures. The reference profile refuses triggers and track-mode effects until their full expansion is implemented.
expansion.parts: Count every band-visible authored/expanded part whose ancestors are visible, including empty pivots. Exclude root and face/effect pseudo-groups. Additionally count transform-only clip target owners and required ancestors once, even when suppressed for painting; the reference profile refuses such hidden-owner closures until supported.
expansion.gradient: Count each actual gradient fill/stroke invocation. Solid emitter colour replaces source paints, so its shadow mask does not invoke the source gradient again. Shared paint ids never deduplicate normal invocations.
expansion.opacity: Suppress an item only if its effective alpha/opacity is provably zero in every reachable rest, pose, mood, reduced state, held control and track. A resting zero does not suppress a later positive state. Bounds include any reachable enabled fill/stroke/outline/emission.
expansion.bands: Resolve each band independently from the full recipe. An explicit band variant overrides rest, pose, mood, discrete track and switch variants; variant anchors use that final band variant. Apply hidden ancestors, item bands and outline/face/glow policy before counting.
expansion.resolved_overrides: Resolve complete face style replacements then numeric tune before expansion; positive tuned glints and other operations count. Resolve ordinary/reduced mood item paint overrides and reachable visibility/opacity/variant tracks before taking per-component bounds. Accessory-level band overrides use the same rules as character/part bands. Unsupported reference constructs must fail, not count as free.
expansion.faceless: A faceless character cannot map kit effects or use kit effect triggers; it may draw and animate ordinary parts instead.
expansion.host_swap: Freeze the outgoing character as a cached bitmap. Each swap frame has the incoming character bound plus at most two host drawImage composite passes, not a redraw of two vector characters. These host passes and two backing images are separate E5c workload/allocation obligations, not silently omitted performance work.

maximisation.result: Sum each part component maximum, each exclusive accessory-slot maximum, the face bound, ground and concurrent effects; blur uses max. Each metric has its own component proof. This is a conservative integer upper bound, not the exact joint-frame maximum; component choices can be mutually inconsistent across shared clip targets.
maximisation.controls: Bound all reachable rest/pose/mood/reduced/held/track values. Resolve face styles/tune first, then maximise each eye-plus-allowed-brow and mouth separately. Account for effects per concurrent instance; require R and JS to reproduce the same integer upper-bound policy.
maximisation.exclusive_choices: Take a maximum, never a sum, over alternatives within one part or accessory slot. For cross-component clip targets take the largest geometry cost over band-resolved variants; a same-part item clip uses its already selected source variant. Sum independent components even when correlation makes the result conservative.
maximisation.canonical_profile: The reference supports the four current resolved recipes plus documented hand probes. It refuses unsupported semantic constructs; no generic full-format state-machine or renderer claim. It does not enumerate the Cartesian product of parts and slots.
maximisation.motion_counts: Structural bounds inspect all band-resolved part alternatives without the old equal-cost switch refusal. Default-invisible/zero-opacity parts, structural tracks and overrides remain refused by this reference until full reachability/closure support exists.

glow_area.formula: For each compatible blurred paint operation of an emitter/glyph, bound the local primitive/control-point box including stroke extent. Its diagonal times the ancestor maximum scale norms and applicable face/anchor scale bounds its transformed box side under arbitrary rotation. Add 6*blur, square, sum once per blurred operation and divide by 90000. Round one floating-point step outward and then up to 12 decimal places; zero emission stays zero.
glow_area.scale_scope: Authored rest/pose/mood/gesture extrema plus multiplicative idle breathing: each axis multiplies by a factor in [1-breathe,1+breathe]. Built-in hop is lift-only, height*sin(pi*u), with no scale contribution; squash must be an explicit bounded track. Attachment roots include anchor.scale and all reachable variant-anchor scale maxima. Translation changes no area. External held root/part/face scale requires the same live bound before acceptance; attachment glow remains refused by the reference.
glow_area.runtime: If the supported conservative bound exceeds the target-band limit, reject the whole resource-sensitive update before applying any field unless a tighter proved bound passes. No silent clamping or dropping glow. Stress rows are reference calculations, not executed runtime rejections.
glow_area.not_proved: The enclosing-circle bound is conservative, not a pixel/performance/fit proof. A rotation-aware tighter box is optional only with a proved reachable rotation interval. Normalised area does not bound absolute backing pixels at arbitrary CSS width/DPR; E5c and allocation-policy decisions remain.

compatibility.counting: Any change to item/pass/operand/instance/upper-bound semantics increments operation_manifest_version. Current version 2 supersedes unfrozen version 1. After freeze, format v1 retains its frozen accounting/admission semantics: a changed count requires a new format version or an explicit compatible old-admission path, never silently invalidating a formerly valid file.
compatibility.limits: Numeric/input limit policy changes increment policy_version. After format-v1 freeze, ceilings may be raised but never lowered for the same accounting version; admission cannot invalidate previously accepted files. Counting changes require explicit compatibility/revalidation, not an unnoticed limit edit.
compatibility.freeze: Rules and numeric caps are not declared frozen by these reference checks; full fixtures, independent reproduction and remaining product/allocation choices precede freeze.
